column1: # MARKER CLASSES -- the family a marker belongs to, and what that family looks
# like by default.
# A row in markers.tsv names its class; the class supplies the default SHAPE and
# COLOUR, and the row overrides either one.
# ⭐ WHY CLASSES EXIST (DL J7, 2026-08-04). Every marker used to be a confidence
# claim, and that narrowness was genuinely the feature: you can ask "what is
# unconfirmed across this whole site" only while every row answers the same
# question. When terminology arrived it was nearly built as a SECOND, parallel
# family -- two mechanisms for one concept -- because the table had no way to say
# which KIND a row was. Michael's ruling: it IS a marker, put it in markers, you
# have found CLASSES. The report groups by class, so the confidence question stays
# answerable no matter how many glossary terms a site marks.
# ADDING A MARKER is a row in markers.tsv. ADDING A WHOLE FAMILY is a row here.
# Neither is a code change and neither is a CSS change -- the class colour is
# emitted as generated CSS by docrender/markers.py.
# COLUMNS
# class    the token a markers.tsv row names
# shape    default shape for the family: box · plain · strike · soft
# color    default colour: any token the engine emits, or a literal hex/oklch
# label    what this family MEANS. For the reader of this file and the report.
# ⭐ THE CANONICAL PALETTE IS REACHABLE FROM HERE AS OF 2026-08-05, and until
# that day it was not. markers.py validated every colour against the nine-token
# stand-in in theme/colors.tsv, so a cell naming a real design-system token was
# refused and quietly rendered as body text.
# 🔴 WHICH MEANS `terminology` WAS WRONG FROM THE DAY IT WAS WRITTEN, and the
# refusal was accidentally protecting the site from it. It asked for
# `accent-soft`, which measures 1.29 on the dark canvas and 1.12 on the light
# one against a floor of 4.5 -- because accent-soft is a WASH, the tinted
# background BEHIND a chip, and never a letters colour. Wiring the token list
# without measuring would have turned every glossary term on the site from
# legible-but-wrong into invisible.
# It now names `accent-2` -- the Eos TRACKED violet -- which measures 6.63 dark
# and 5.81 light on canvas. ⭐ And the note this replaces PREDICTED THIS EXACT
# SWAP: "swapping it to accent-2 later is a data edit that touches no code
# anywhere." True, and worth keeping as the reason to name a token in ONE CELL.
# The moment a second surface hardcodes it, that promise is dead.
class
